# A confined rise within a whole, and what a founding carries

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`confined-rise-within-a-whole` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](confined-rise-within-a-whole.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A lineage confined to a whole's conditions in excess has no member once they end, whatever selection within raised; selection within a whole founded uniform needs variation arisen in it; where next founders carry their founder's value, selection among wholes decides the rise.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Where a family of conditions ran into excess under the coupled gate, every member of a later generation of descent is the offspring of a member that depended on no condition of the family at the gate's need, and a lineage every later member of which depends on the family has no member after its end. (`Becoming.Founding.Flow.survivors_independent`, `Becoming.Founding.Flow.confined_ends`, `Becoming.Founding.nil_of_none`)
2. A rise: a lineage marked by an amount that selection within goes for before the end, taking from the family during its excess, the family's renewal gated and in excess. Confined (every later member depending on the family), it has no member after the end, whatever selection within had raised it to. (`Becoming.Founding.Flow.Rise`, `Becoming.Founding.Flow.ConfinedRise`, `Becoming.Founding.Flow.ConfinedRise.ends`)
3. In generations founded uniform, exact transmission keeps every later member at the founding value, so nothing is selected within; wherever offspring number is concordant or discordant with the amount at a step, transmission raised or lowered it at some step before. (`Becoming.Founding.uniform_until`, `Becoming.Founding.none_within_until`, `Becoming.Founding.exact_of_none`, `Becoming.Founding.changed_or_none`, `Becoming.Founding.varied_before`, `Becoming.Founding.of_mem_single`)
4. Over wholes each founded by one part, transmission across a generation of wholes is how far the next founders moved from their founder within the whole; where they carry the founder's value, the mean founding value rises exactly where selection among wholes goes for it. (`Becoming.Founding.Nested`, `Becoming.Founding.Nested.Founded`, `Becoming.Founding.Nested.Sequestered`, `Becoming.Founding.Nested.raised_carried`, `Becoming.Founding.Nested.lowered_carried`, `Becoming.Founding.Nested.raises_iff_carried`, `Becoming.Founding.Nested.exact_of_sequestered`, `Becoming.Founding.Nested.raises_iff_among`, `Becoming.Founding.Nested.varied_within`)
5. Witness Body: two lineages each meet every clause of a rise on one body; the confined one ends, the one whose descendant depends on a condition outside the body still has a member a generation after every part depending on the body has ended. (`Becoming.Founding.Body.balances`, `Becoming.Founding.Body.acting`, `Becoming.Founding.Body.dependent`, `Becoming.Founding.Body.descended`, `Becoming.Founding.Body.confined_marks`, `Becoming.Founding.Body.confined_rise`, `Becoming.Founding.Body.confined_ended`, `Becoming.Founding.Body.spread_marks`, `Becoming.Founding.Body.spread_rise`, `Becoming.Founding.Body.spread_unconfined`, `Becoming.Founding.Body.body_ended`, `Becoming.Founding.Body.spread_outlasts`)
6. Witness Germline: a variant not holding back arises within a whole and is selected for within it; with the next founder from the line carrying the founder's value the mean founding value rises from a half to one, with the founders from the variants it falls from a half to none although selection among wholes goes for holding back. (`Becoming.Founding.Germline.within_against`, `Becoming.Founding.Germline.sequestered_founded`, `Becoming.Founding.Germline.sequestered_sequestered`, `Becoming.Founding.Germline.sequestered_rises`, `Becoming.Founding.Germline.unsequestered_founded`, `Becoming.Founding.Germline.unsequestered_falls`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. On the base, balance, only active formations giving, activity needing support, descent, the coupled gate on the family and n steps of its excess from a stock below n + m; confinement as a hypothesis of the lineage law. For varied_before, a first generation uniform in the amount. For the founding laws, one founder per whole carrying the whole's value and next founders among its members (Founded), and for the among-wholes law, foundings carrying the founder's value (Sequestered).

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- How parts first come to live as one (the major transitions themselves): the laws hold of a whole once formed and of its foundings.
- That a given tumour meets the clauses of ConfinedRise, or that a given germ line is sequestered: empirical. Confinement, the excess and how founders are drawn are hypotheses wherever they enter.
- Wholes founded by several parts (colonial and aggregative routes), removal of parts by the whole's rule (policing in the literature), and a lineage founding a new whole elsewhere are not stated; the spreading witness has a member for one generation past the end.
- Sequestered states an outcome (each next founder carries its founder's value), not a mechanism; germ lines do vary, and the rise's drawing clause says the lineage takes from the family during the excess, not that it causes it.
- That a lineage ending with its whole is worse, or that sequestration is better: the counts read who leaves descendants; ranking goes through the comparison C.
- **Counterexample:** Confinement is needed: in Body the spreading lineage is a rise on the same body (Body.spread_rise), its descendant depends on a condition outside the body, and it has a member after the body's parts end (Body.spread_unconfined, Body.spread_outlasts). Sequestration is needed for the among-wholes law: in Germline with the founders from the variants the mean founding value falls although selection among wholes goes for holding back (Germline.unsequestered_falls). <a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Buss 1987 and Michod 1999 (with Michod and Roze 2001) read the transitions in individuality through selection within and among organisms: a single-cell bottleneck (Grosberg and Strathmann 1998) reduces variation within, a sequestered germ line reduces the within-organism change in what founding transmits, and within-organism selection enters the organism level as transmission bias (the transmission term of Price 1970, 1972). Aktipis et al. 2015 read cancer as cheating on the foundations of multicellular cooperation; Metzger et al. 2015 report transmissible cancers. Readings (the AI's): ConfinedRise as cancer, Sequestered as a germ line where it does not vary, Founded with one founder as the bottleneck, a rise whose confinement fails as a transmissible cancer.
